text.text_excerpt: I fell in Love with NOLA after visiting Kermit's. So much culture and love within the environment. There was also a live band present which def had the crowd moving. To be in a place with good music and people ; was so damn peaceful. Make sure you come to Kermit's prepared to dance. The music definitely set the tone ; and everyone was dancing. Not much of a drinker ; so didn't order a drink. But Kermit's also sells food; didn't get a chance to taste. Everyone should visit Kermit's and the men that come to party are handsome and respectable. If you're not looking for a party and not a friendly person ; don't go to Kermit's. Street food is also available down among the strip.

Seriously by far my favorite bar in NOLA. We love that they pretty much always have a live DJ that goes super hard! We have caught second lines coming thru here. We have caught Kermit Ruffins chilling here at the bar on several occasions. We have had some of our favorite meals here. Never paid for the food. It's always like a little family type atmosphere. Make sure to tip the bartender and be cool

If you are a Kermit Ruffins' fan, this is the place to be and one of our favorite intimate music experiences during our most recent trip to NOLA! We found out on his Facebook page that he was planning on performing here at this small bar/lounge on Monday night before being back on the road again. (His post said he'd start at 6pm, in reality the music started just after 7) Although not advertised, there is a $20 cover when he's playing - which we were charged after sitting around for a while with our drinks since we came so early.
